question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a980930c664288f19b0caa73d1edbff51a6982fcaf45284b6a872567970da7ea.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Figure rotates in an anticlockwise direction by 90° and line inside the circle is also rotating.

Number of lines outside of the figure is increasing by 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2c7910ef03165f29bb1c269542a16bb93edf954cf84b6fe5e0f35d7dc69aef2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
